content_md: I am of the opinion that human x AI conversations capture human thinking much more precisely than any singular essay human has written on that topic from those conversations. If that's the case we really don't have a good anchor to communicate these new artifacts. These conversations are the raw backend material, and are not typically read friendly to others. A frontend prompt material needs to exist to make it readable, and we need a sharable internet anchor to communicate these.
